Players Committee card image of [[Dathcha (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Scavenger. Once per turn, if your droid just deployed to same site, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck (may take one into hand). During battle here, may forfeit Dathcha (or one non-[permanent weapon] droid) to Used Pile (using forfeit value = 3).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/dathcha.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
